questions.stem: According to the passage, what does the word "yoga" mean in the Sanskrit language?
questions.evidence: The word itself comes from the Sanskrit language and means “union.”
questions.explanation_ko: 요가라는 단어는 산스크리트어에서 유래했으며 '결합'을 의미한다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT described as good for beginners or those recovering from injury?
questions.evidence: I wouldn’t really encourage them to start in a higher level vinyasa flow class because they’re not going to have the foundation to move safely through that
questions.explanation_ko: 높은 단계의 빈야사 플로우 수업은 안전하게 나아갈 기초가 없는 초보자에게 권장되지 않는다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from Van Valkenburg's comment that people who try yoga once might be "missing" a lot?
options: All yoga classes are essentially identical no matter the style or teacher.
Because yoga varies so much between styles and teachers, one class may not represent the full range of options available.
People who dislike their first yoga class should never try yoga again.
Yin yoga is objectively the best style for every beginner.
questions.evidence: there’s just so much out there that you might be missing
questions.explanation_ko: 놓치고 있을 수 있는 것이 아주 많다는 말에서, 요가는 스타일과 강사에 따라 매우 다양해 한 번의 수업이 전체를 대표하지 않을 수 있음을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author quote yoga teacher Tim Senesi saying "The best is the one that works for you"?
options: To emphasize that there is no single correct style of yoga for everyone
To argue that hatha yoga is superior to all other styles
To criticize teachers who specialize in only one method
To explain the history of the Sanskrit language
questions.evidence: “The best is the one that works for you,” said Tim Senesi
questions.explanation_ko: 이 인용문은 모두에게 맞는 단 하나의 정답 스타일은 없다는 점을 강조하기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "aligning" mean in "Iyengar yoga pays special attention to carefully moving or aligning parts of the body"?
options: positioning something correctly in relation to other things
questions.evidence: Iyengar yoga pays special attention to carefully moving or aligning parts of the body
questions.explanation_ko: align은 신체 부위를 다른 것과의 관계 속에서 올바르게 위치시킨다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.expression: many different paths leading toward the same aim
blanks.meaning: 같은 목표로 이어지는 여러 다른 길
blanks.sentence_ko: 같은 목표로 이어지는 여러 다른 길이 있습니다, 라고 그는 덧붙였다.
몸을 억지로 밀어붙이기보다 자세에 편안히 자리 잡도록 한다.
학생들은 매일 그 동작들을 반복하며, 흔히 자기만의 속도로 나아간다.
무엇보다도, 자신에게 잘 맞는 방식이나 강사를 찾을 때까지 몇몇 수업을 시도해 보라.

key_points: Yoga, a Sanskrit word meaning 'union,' takes many forms worldwide, and teachers say the best style for a beginner is simply the one that works for that person.
Hatha and yin styles tend to be gentler and slower, focusing on breathing and recovery, making them good starting points for relaxation and flexibility.
Vinyasa and ashtanga are more physically demanding, flowing styles better suited to athletic students, though even athletic beginners are advised to start at a beginner level.
Iyengar yoga moves slowly and focuses on precise body alignment, often using supportive equipment, making it good for people recovering from injury or wanting a strong foundation.
main_idea: Because yoga comes in many different styles with different paces and goals, teachers say beginners should try several kinds to find the one that best fits their body and needs.
restate_sentence: For some, yoga is an exercise centered on mindful breathing and slow movement.
